acceptanceEvidence.evidence: page328-browser-tools exercises the real registry, employee service and browser manager with Playwright mocked; the own-account self state crosses the browser boundary. page328-browser-sessions verifies both workspace and yolo against SessionService and the real cookie codec.

page328-browser-tools verifies the current-administrator facade can see, pause, resume and stop a live agent browser with session revocation; foreign/admin profiles and takeover are refused. Existing chat/browser UI and the Chats page show the live panel with agent names. page328-browser-access verifies the corresponding controls and access/profile display.

Only changed-file Prettier and explicitly selected isolated Vitest files were run. No pnpm run check/lint/test scripts, full suites, application, browser, network/database functional tests, build or screenshot acceptance were started.

decisions: Only self is offered to agents; optional additional external profiles are deferred. No administrator profile can be selected or saved by an agent.

The later explicit privacy requirement takes precedence over the earlier working-folder wording: storageState lives in the protected instance runtime, outside all work/chat folders, 0600 in 0700 directories; only its own conversation mount reaches isolated CLI sessions.

All changes of the employee configuration revoke an issued session, including every access-level reduction. Authentication rechecks fresh facts on every request; a 250 ms supervisor also closes idle revoked browsers.

Existing employee access levels apply to employee jobs in chats, groups, learning and automation. Plan steps keep their existing run options and executing identity; human-owned plan steps are not impersonated as employee accounts.
